verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-VM provisioning. That includes multi-GPU machines with up to 8 A100s and NVLink between GPUs inside one machine, plus private networks and shared drives between separate machines. Nothing documents provisioning a multi-node GPU cluster with a fast inter-node interconnect for distributed training. NVLink is an intra-node, adjacent feature, and wiring machines together over a private network is a user-side workaround. High-end GPUs such as H100 also require an approval request.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle

citations.quote: Enhance data transfer speeds and scalability between NVIDIA GPUs for high-performance computing tasks by enabling NVLink.
Leverage the latest NVIDIA GPUs including Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs.
Shared drives provide storage that is accessible from multiple machines in a private network.
If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
